scope: A2 endpoint protocol; no feature extraction or quality scoring during preparation
training_loss: unclamped source VGG LPIPS on [0,1] plus L1; source M3 denoising SUM

reconstruction.encoding: per-image seeded independent Gaussian64 prefixes; tau Uniform[0,.01)

generation.labels: class index repeated50; common labels and Gaussian prefixes for both joint arms
generation.fixed_count: native model count; no source image inputs, selector, or length conditioning
generation.nfe: count actual GE evaluations;50 grid points are not50 NFE
generation.gate: both joint arms finite and improving on the same fixed512DEV; no crashed-arm generation

features.name: inception-v3-compat
features.fid: pinned utils.fid.compute_fid_from_features; FP64,N-1,SciPy sqrtm;1e-6 diagonal fallback only nonfinite
features.pilot_reference: cache ImageNet100 FIT features with immutable manifest and feature hash; not full1K published stats
features.pilot_reference_features_sha256_reason: Not extracted in preparation; missing endpoint prerequisite
features.kid: unbiased degree3 polynomial,gamma1/2048,coef1;100 paired fixed subsets of1000 without replacement
features.rfid: same named DEV real and reconstruction feature rows; never compare unlike split statistics

gradient_probe.generation_reduction: one shared draw per image at each fixed t; M3 identical repeats divided by3
gradient_probe.parameters: last shared GE block, sorted parameter names
gradient_probe.report: per-image norms,cosines,reconstruction difficulty,each t and arithmetic mean

a2_interference_gate.measure: mean shared allocation distortion on the exact same balanced DEV rows

collapse_gate: variance<10% stable same-interface control AND >=20% worse held-out reconstruction at two checkpoints
plateau_gate: finite, no meaningful held-out improvement over last three measurements; report actual exposure
estimates: advisory only; Section15.2 matched extensions require original/revised config hashes,endpoints,controls,expected and actual cost
preparation_outcome_class_reason: Unrun model training is not a scientific negative
